propositions: Ticking AC checkboxes does not invalidate attestations because checkbox state is normalized out before hashing, but staleness messages incorrectly named a fictional 'AC' component instead of the actual basis keys.

Pre-330c attestations hash raw descriptions, causing false staleness reports on unchanged tickets after checkbox normalization was introduced, because neither the current normalized hash nor the legacy grandfather can match.

The material basis is a single composite sha256 over exactly ticket_id, description, file_impact, children, and file_impact_scope (when scope is none), but every current staleness message claims the fixed list 'description/AC/file_impact/children'.

Per-component fingerprints must be recorded in the signed manifest as additive 'material-part: <name> <hash16> <size>' lines so the reason can name which component actually changed without reconstructing state that might disagree with what the reviewer saw.

Staleness messages must be updated across all surfaces (claim gate, close gate, generation, resignation, completion verification, CLI) to either name differing components or plainly state when none can be named, replacing fixed fictional lists.
